fixture_purpose: pin frozen error classification subset (T0 contract freeze)

error_kinds.description: Generic TCP / DNS / TLS network error before HTTP response
Upstream connection closed before stream terminator (no done event)
Upstream returned 2xx but with empty body / zero tokens
Routing decision unstable (credential cooling / probing) — candidate may become available
Node in transient state (probing / recovering) — not admissible yet
Queue admission refusal at full scheduling queue; immediate rejection, retryable (503 + Retry-After)
No routable credential/model at all for this tenant + model (terminal for this attempt)
Requested model does not exist or is not bindable to any credential
Upstream rate-limit hit (HTTP 429); retryable after backoff
Tenant quota exhausted; retryable only after quota reset

extension_policy: Adding a new error_kind requires updating this fixture + requestjourney contract; the dispatch-sourced subset is open-but-frozen-as-pinned.
validation_rules: error_kind values MUST be drawn from this subset (or be open-vocabulary extensions deliberately added)
error_kind MUST be a snake_case lowercase string
error_kind MUST NOT leak request body, prompt, response, or API key
